description: Connect a Slack channel so Databuddy posts investigations and answers there, or remove it. Removing stops the posts; the app stays in the channel and a mention adds it back. Preview first; apply after the user approves.

confirmed.description: Preview first; set true after user approval to apply the displayed change.

connected.description: true connects the channel; false removes it.

workspaceId.description: Workspace ID from list_slack_channels, for a channel shared by two connected workspaces.

name: set_slack_channel

outputSchema.description: message describes the outcome. preview and confirmationRequired identify a review without writing; current and updates show proposed edits when present. channel is the Slack channel; success confirms an applied mutation.

title: Set slack channel
